messages:
maya: heads up — invoice-preview alert just flagged ~0.3% of tokens being attributed to SKU 'free-tier' after the route-priority canary rolled out at 10:17 UTC. seeing negative reserved_credit for a handful of tenants.
jonah: ugh. which canary? the routing-priority v2 that landed this morning?
arjun: yep that one. we changed header normalization behavior so older clientlib route hints were dropped in the proxy.
maya: logs show route_resolution_id is null for affected events. sample payload:
```
{
  "client_id": "acct-9876",
  "route_hint": null,
  "route_resolution_id": null,
  "tokens": 142
}
```
lia: billing-preview spikes came from the hourly job that rolls up per-route aggregates into preview. it uses route_resolution_id to apply overrides/discounts.
billing-bot: alert: invoice-preview delta > 0.5% for 12 tenants. Impact estimate: ~$1200 forecasted drift in previews (not yet invoiced).
jonah: quick mitigation ideas: 1) pause canary 2) fallback mapping that treats null resolution as previous-route for 72h 3) shadow-replay to recompute previews for affected tenants.
arjun: pausing rollout now via deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated for routing-priority v2 canary -> target groups: 5% -> 0%. status: 12 nodes draining.
maya: good. also need a detection query to find all events that lost route_resolution_id during the 10:17–10:40 window. putting one together:
```
select tenant_id, count(*) as c
from events
where timestamp >= '2026-03-22T10:17:00Z'
  and timestamp <= '2026-03-22T10:40:00Z'
  and route_resolution_id is null
group by tenant_id
order by c desc
limit 200
```
lia: run that and feed results to the preview backfill job. but we should avoid recomputing everything — only recompute town-of-tenants with c > 50.
jonah: agree. also add a short-term guard in preview job: if route_resolution_id is null and previously had mapping, use last-known mapping (TTL 7 days).
arjun: we don't actually persist last mapping in the ingest path currently; store would be in route-cache (redis). i can push a small fallback write that updates route-cache on resolution and set short TTL.
maya: sounds good. who's owning the backfill?
lia: i'll own the preview backfill orchestration. will coordinate with arjun for route-cache patch and with billing for reconciliation thresholds.
billing-bot: scheduled job queued: preview-backfill-job for tenants list ready. ETA to start: 30m after tenant list is posted.
jonah: follow-up: we should add an ingest validation that emits a high-signal metric when route_resolution_id transitions from non-null to null for the same session_id within 5 minutes — that would catch header normalization regressions during rolling deploys.
arjun: adding that metric now (ingest.metrics.increment('route_resolution_lost')) — will ship as hotfix to proxy in 15m.
maya: action items: (1) arjun — hotfixmetric + route-cache fallback write (2) lia — run detection query + kick preview backfill (3) jonah — add alert for route_resolution_lost > 5/min (4) billing — hold invoice finalization for impacted tenants for next 24h or until reconciled.
jonah: wrote the alert doc in the runbook -> /runbooks/route-resolution-regressions.md :thumbsup:
arjun: hotfix pushed to canary nodes, metric emitted in staging. will monitor.
lia: detection query run -> 18 tenants > 50 events. posting list to the preview-backfill queue now.
billing-bot: preview-backfill-job started for 18 tenants. progress: 0/18.
maya: thanks all. let's sync in 1 hour if backfill still running. please add any suspects to the thread. :eyes:
